title: geum flavum
intro: Geum flavum, commonly known as the yellow avens, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Geum flavum are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are present in the plant's roots, leaves, and flowers.
